name: sparsew2t data: crypto pumps (pump table + Binance Vision 1h + anchors)
command: set -eo pipefail; D=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; mkdir -p $D/pnd $D/crypto; echo '[1/3] pump table'; curl -fsSL -m 60 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' https://api.github.com/repos/SystemsLab-Sapienza/pump-and-dump-dataset/contents/pump_telegram.csv -o $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv || curl -fsSL -m 60 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SystemsLab-Sapienza/pump-and-dump-dataset/master/pump_telegram.csv -o $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv; head -1 $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv | grep -q '^symbol,group,date' || { echo 'pump table download failed'; exit 1; }; echo "pump rows $(wc -l < $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv)"; echo '[2/3] binance vision'; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python scripts/data_fetch/fetch_binance_pnd.py --pumps $D/pnd/pump_telegram.csv --out $D/crypto 2>&1 | tail -n 5; echo '[3/3] anchors'; ln -sfn $D data; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -W ignore scripts/build_anchors.py --config configs/default.yaml --dataset-config configs/datasets/crypto_pnd_fast.yaml --sheet $D/crypto/pnd_sheet.csv --out $D/crypto/pnd_anchors.csv 2>&1 | tail -n 8; rm -f data; touch $D/DONE
